caseStudies.title: Forklift Pre-start Check
caseStudies.summary: Apprentices walk around a virtual forklift, find the faults and complete the pre-start checklist before they go near a real machine.
caseStudies.challenge: Machine time is limited and first sessions carry real safety risk. Trainers wanted learners arriving at the yard already confident with the checklist.
caseStudies.approach: A scanned forklift model with faults that change every attempt, and each checklist step reported to the LMS through xAPI.
caseStudies.outcome: [XX]% of learners passed the practical pre-start check on their first attempt.

card.alt: [Photo: apprentice in a headset beside a training forklift]

experience.label: Interactive 3D · WebXR
experience.note: Runs in the browser with mouse or touch. Connect a Meta Quest and select Enter VR for the full simulation.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: forklift scene in the game engine
assets.alt: [Screenshot of the forklift scene in the game engine]

caseStudies.title: Ward Orientation 360
caseStudies.summary: Graduate nurses explore a medical ward in 360° before their first shift, finding equipment, emergency exits and handover points.
caseStudies.challenge: Physical orientation tours pulled senior nurses off the floor during busy intake periods.
caseStudies.approach: A 360° capture of a working ward, with hotspots linking to short clips from nurse educators and a check question at each zone.
caseStudies.outcome: [Hours of supervised orientation saved per intake].

card.alt: [Photo: graduate nurse viewing a 360° ward tour on a tablet]

experience.label: 360° scene · hotspots
experience.note: Drag to look around, or select a hotspot. Works on desktop, phone and headset.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: 360° camera capture on the ward
assets.alt: [Photo of the 360° camera on the ward]

caseStudies.title: Site Hazard Spotter
caseStudies.summary: Learners scan a construction site for hazards against the clock, then replay the scene to see what they missed.
caseStudies.challenge: Static WHS slides were not changing how inspectors noticed hazards on real sites.
caseStudies.approach: A modular 3D site where hazards can be swapped per industry, with a replay that highlights missed items and explains each one.
caseStudies.outcome: [XX] learners completed the module in its first quarter, with [XX]% average hazard detection.

card.alt: [Photo: learner at a laptop identifying hazards on a 3D building site]

experience.label: Interactive 3D · WebXR
experience.note: Plays in any modern browser. No install needed.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: lighting pass on the site model

caseStudies.title: Engine Bay Explorer
caseStudies.summary: Students point a tablet at a training engine to label components and step through a timing belt change.
caseStudies.challenge: Workshop engines are shared between many students, and manuals are hard to follow with greasy hands.
caseStudies.approach: An AR app that recognises the engine and overlays labels and animated steps, with a quiz mode for revision.

card.alt: [Photo: student pointing a tablet at a training engine with AR labels]

experience.label: Video walkthrough
experience.note: AR runs on a tablet, so this page shows a recorded walkthrough of the app in use.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: testing in the workshop

caseStudies.title: Difficult Conversations
caseStudies.summary: Volunteers practise responding to a distressed caller, with a virtual character who reacts to each choice they make.
caseStudies.challenge: Role-plays depended on trainer availability, and volunteers felt unprepared for their first real call.
caseStudies.approach: A branching script written with experienced volunteers, voiced by actors, with feedback after each conversation path.
caseStudies.outcome: [Change in self-reported confidence before and after].

card.alt: [Photo: volunteer in a headset practising a conversation]

experience.label: Interactive 3D · branching
experience.note: Choose responses with mouse, touch or VR controllers. Includes content notes before starting.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: voice recording session

caseStudies.title: Umpire Decision Trainer
caseStudies.summary: Community umpires watch match moments from an on-field position and make the call before the clock runs out.
caseStudies.challenge: New umpires get few chances to practise split-second calls before officiating real games.
caseStudies.approach: 360° footage filmed from umpire positions, paused at key moments for a timed decision, then replayed with an expert's explanation.

experience.label: 360° video · timed decisions
experience.note: Drag to look around the field. Best in a headset or on a phone.

assets.caption: Camera rig positions on the field

caseStudies.title: Solar Panel Installer
caseStudies.summary: Electrical students place virtual panels and wiring on a real roof mock-up, with the headset checking spacing and cable runs.
caseStudies.challenge: Real panels and inverters are costly, and mistakes on live equipment are dangerous.
caseStudies.approach: A mixed reality app that anchors virtual panels to the classroom roof rig and checks each step against the standard.

card.alt: [Photo: student placing virtual solar panels on a real roof model]

experience.label: Mixed reality · recorded walkthrough
experience.note: Mixed reality runs on a headset, so this page shows a recorded walkthrough.

assets.caption: Behind the scenes: testing on the roof rig
assets.alt: [Photo of testing on the roof rig]

caseStudies.title: Museum Object Handling
caseStudies.summary: Volunteers learn to handle fragile artefacts by turning scanned 3D objects in their hands through a phone, with handling tips at each touch point.
caseStudies.challenge: Volunteers could not practise on real collection items before working with them.
caseStudies.approach: Photogrammetry scans of collection objects shown in WebAR, with hotspots on safe and unsafe grip points.

card.alt: [Photo: volunteer turning a 3D artefact on a phone]

experience.label: WebAR · interactive 3D
experience.note: Opens in the phone browser. No app needed.
